jr is a Jira client whose output is a versioned contract.

Every result carries a kind and a schema version. A result set that was
truncated is never reported as complete: it exits 3 and says so. Any request
that cannot be honored exactly fails instead of approximating.

stdout carries the result and nothing else. Warnings and errors are structured
and go to stderr.

Usage:
  jr [flags]
  jr [command]

Available Commands:
  auth        Authenticate against a Jira site
  board       Work with boards
  context     Manage named site/project contexts
  contract    Dump the machine-readable output contract for every kind
  epic        Work with epics
  field       Discover fields, including custom fields
  help        Help about any command
  issue       Work with issues
  jql         Validate and explain JQL without executing it
  meta        Ask Jira what can be done to an issue
  project     Inspect projects
  schema      Describe every command this build contains
  sprint      Work with sprints
  user        Look up users
  version     Print the build identity and its compiled-in capabilities

Flags:
      --board string       board id, overriding the context's
      --context string     use this context for one invocation, without selecting it
      --contract           dump the machine-readable output contract for every kind
      --debug              trace HTTP requests to stderr; credentials are redacted in the transport
      --describe           print this command's schema instead of running it
      --format string      output format: tsv|xml|json|yaml (default: tsv for lists, xml for records)
  -h, --help               help for jr
      --max-requests int   cap total HTTP calls for this invocation; 0 means no cap
      --project string     project key, overriding the context's
      --readonly           refuse any command that would change Jira
      --refresh            ignore cached site metadata and probe again
      --retries int        retry budget per request; exhausting it exits 8 or 9, never 0 (default 3)
      --site string        Jira site, overriding the context's

Use "jr [command] --help" for more information about a command.
